canonical_source.behavior: The canonical error page exposes a navigation-only Open logs anchor whose source destination is /logs.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: Because the public Error route has no tenant parameter, Laravel renders Open logs only when the authenticated identity has exactly one active tenant membership authorized for both Logs permissions. The target is then generated from the existing guarded tenant Logs alias; zero or multiple eligible tenants fail closed.

runtime_path: ErrorReadController resolves exactly one eligible tenant from authenticated active memberships
platform.error Blade view renders AIMW-CONT-8B3518EF80 only when logsHref is authoritative

authorization.source_authentication: anonymous route; control itself is absent for guests
authorization.source_tenant_context: not resolved by the Error route
authorization.tenant_selection: derived only from authenticated active memberships; exactly one Logs-authorized tenant is required
authorization.security_result: No caller-provided tenant/resource identifier is accepted by the control. Guest, unauthorized, ambiguous multi-tenant, and foreign-tenant paths fail closed.

semantics.persistence: read-only authorization over existing membership/role/permission state
semantics.external_dependency: The canonical scanner records WordPress, but this navigation operation performs no WordPress/provider request.

coverage: exact canonical PENDING operation identity and source metadata
existing guarded tenant Logs alias and real Logs workspace are the only destination authority
one authorized tenant renders exact operation marker and tenant-qualified href
guest and missing-permission identities do not receive the control
multiple Logs-authorized tenant memberships fail closed instead of choosing arbitrarily
multiple memberships with exactly one authorized tenant resolve only that tenant
foreign tenant requests return 404 and missing destination permission returns 403

Copy error details AIMW-SYNC-89777052CB remains unimplemented and unclaimed

ci_policy.authority: GitHub Actions on the exact final pushed PR head

terminality.basis: Real source-equivalent navigation is bound to the canonical operation and reaches only the existing guarded tenant Logs authority when tenant selection is unambiguous and authorized. Final VERIFIED_TASK_COMPLETE additionally requires exact-head CI success.
